blurb: Flying Lady Boat Tours offers narrated sightseeing boat tours including historic and celebrity home tours, sunset cruises, and sandbar and swim experiences. Tours depart from Guanabanas in Jupiter and Riviera Beach Marina in West Palm Beach. Wildlife sightings may include manatees, turtles, dolphins, and coastal birds.
extraNote: No booking fees; online booking available · Tours operate rain or shine; weather policies detailed on FAQ · Cancellation and refund policies available on FAQ page · Departures from Guanabanas (Jupiter) and Riviera Beach Marina (West Palm Beach)
